summary: Iteration 99 verification of the 4 reported /retailer/login bugs. Backend: GST hard-block + provider_down flag fully verified (15 API/unit tests, 14 pass, 1 real classifier gap). Waitlist admin+applicant email code path verified in-process (both emails attempted: contact.us@centraders.com + applicant). Frontend: IMPORTANT — the preview was serving a STALE Next.js production build (supervisor runs `next start`, .next built Aug-22; page.js edited Aug-23), so none of the Iter-99 frontend changes were live. I ran `yarn build` + `supervisorctl restart frontend`; after that the waitlist hard-block UI (red failure message, blocking toast, no POST) passes. However the input text-colour fix (bug #4) is STILL BROKEN in the default theme: ThemeProvider defaults to dark, so html.dark is set on /retailer/login and globals.css `.dark input{color:#e8eaed}` (specificity 0-2-1) overrides the new `text-[#2B3A4A]` utility (0-1-0) => typed text renders #E8EAED on white (contrast ~1.1:1, illegible). Mobile login.tsx verified by code inspection only (no Expo runtime).

minor.issue: Does not classify the invalid-API-key outage as provider_down. _friendly_upstream_error returns 'GST verification key invalid. Admin: update the Appyflow key in Integrations.' but the classifier only checks for the substring 'invalid key' (wrong word order) => an expired/invalid Appyflow key would HARD-BLOCK every waitlist signup instead of soft-accepting. Suggest checking ('key invalid' or 'invalid key' or 'auth').

ui_bugs.issue: Bug #4 NOT fixed in default (dark) theme. Computed color on both inputs = rgb(232,234,237) on rgb(255,255,255) bg. Cause: context/ThemeContext.js defaults isDarkMode=true -> html gets class 'dark'; app/globals.css base rule `.dark input:not([type=checkbox])... { color:#e8eaed }` has higher specificity than the utility class `text-[#2B3A4A]`. Fix: add `dark:text-[#2B3A4A]` (or `!text-[#2B3A4A]`) to the inputs, or wrap the globals.css dark input rule in :where() so it does not beat explicit utilities. Same rule also washes out the waitlist form inputs (business/contact/email/phone) — their typed text is equally illegible.

integration_issues.issue: supervisor runs `yarn start` = `next start` against a prebuilt .next (no hot reload). Any change under /app/frontend-next requires `yarn build` + `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`, otherwise the preview serves stale code (this is why the old amber 'Could not auto-verify — you can still continue' message and old input styles were still live). I rebuilt and restarted during this run.

issues: Input text #E8EAED on white background — effectively invisible
Waitlist form placeholders/values also near-invisible due to the same .dark input rule

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Stale build: /app/frontend is a symlink to /app/frontend-next and supervisor runs `next start`, serving .next from 2026-08-22 while page.js was edited 2026-08-23 — all Iter-99 frontend changes were invisible until rebuilt. 2) Input legibility: context/ThemeContext.js sets isDarkMode=true by default, adding class 'dark' to <html> on every route; app/globals.css contains a base rule `.dark input:not(...) { color:#e8eaed }` whose specificity (0-2-1) beats the single-class Tailwind utility `text-[#2B3A4A]` (0-1-0), so the intended dark-navy text colour never applies for default visitors. 3) Provider-outage classifier misses the 'key invalid' phrasing produced by _friendly_upstream_error.
